entities.name: Kynureninase
observations: Supplied 426-aa sequence matches reviewed bacterial kynureninases at 50.5–52.4% identity and 99.1% query coverage; functional assignment is homology-supported, not a direct assay of this sequence.
Reference annotation assigns PLP-dependent cleavage of L-kynurenine and 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine.

entities.name: Kynurenine cleavage
observations: L-kynurenine + H2O → anthranilate + L-alanine + H+; EC 3.7.1.3; Rhea RHEA:16813, as assigned to close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: 3-Hydroxykynurenine cleavage
observations: 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + H2O → 3-hydroxyanthranilate + L-alanine + H+; Rhea RHEA:25143, as assigned to close reviewed homologs.
